messages:
Maya: FYI I'm about to land a large content shuffle across docs. Moving docs/api/* -> reference/api/ and splitting 'concepts' into 'guides' + 'concepts'. PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423 — it includes redirects.yml entries and a script to rewrite anchors.
Sam: Can you drop the preview link? want to spot-check anchor jumps before we merge. Also worried about concurrent PRs touching the same paths.
Maya: Preview: https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.ai. Re anchors: I ran `scripts/check-anchors.js` but it flagged ~12 anchors that differ by casing/whitespace. I added a migration map in the PR but would like a second pair of eyes.
Ben: I'll take a look at the preview in the next hour. Quick ask — can we avoid permanent redirects for temporary names? prefer 302 (or the docs site equivalent) until we've verified everything.
Anna: I can volunteer to maintain redirects.yml if we decide to centralize changes. Does the PR include entries like `- from: /api/intro -> to: /reference/api/intro`? if so, let's add a `meta: migration-2026-03` tag so we can remove them after 6 months.
Maya: yes, exactly. snippet in the PR:
```
- from: /api/intro
  to: /reference/api/intro
  status: temporary
  note: migration-2026-03
```
Maya: Also added a small script to assert that redirects resolve in the preview site:
```
curl -sSfL https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.ai/api/intro | grep -q "Reference: API"
```
Carlos: Heads-up: I have PR #8431 open that renames some sdk snippets under docs/examples/sdk/python -> examples/sdk/python. That will conflict with the move if merged concurrently.
Emily: Suggest we sequence merges: 1) #8423 (path reorg + redirects), 2) #8431 (sdk snippet rename) rebased onto new structure, 3) follow-up fix PRs. Hold windows: merge times during low-traffic: Tue/Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Sam: Agree with merge window. For reviewers: @Ben and @Carlos for content, @Anna for redirects. Also add label `do-not-merge` until checks pass.
Ben: I'll review tonight. Two things I'll focus on: anchor stability and examples references in sidebars. If relic links remain, they break the left-nav anchors badly.
Anna: For the redirects centralization — if multiple PRs add entries concurrently, we should gate via a single redirects PR that aggregates changes and then CI runs link-check. Alternatively, we can allow small patches with `redirects/*.yml` and a job to combine them; which do we prefer?
Maya: I prefer single redirects PR to avoid merge collisions. I'll update the docs contributing guide to require redirects changes go into a new `redirects/aggregate-<date>.yml` file that we then squash into redirects.yml during the merge window.
Carlos: I'll put a comment on #8431 to rebase after #8423. Also I'll run our link-check locally:
```
npm run docs:check-links -- --base-url=https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.ai
```
Emily: After the merge, we should run the smoke evals for common customer flows (chat, embeddings, deploy). I'll add a ticket in #product to schedule smoke runs and check for broken SDK snippets in sample apps.
Ben: small nit — in the PR body can you list the top 20 legacy anchors that we changed? that'll help reviewers skim.
Maya: added that list in a new commit. Also added unit tests for the rewrite script.
docs-bot: deploy-preview status: All checks passed for PR #8423. Preview available at https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.ai (build 502). :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all. Plan: hold merge until Ben/Anna sign off, then merge during Tue 02:00 UTC window. I'll coordinate and post again 30m before merge.
Sam: ping me 15m before, I'll queue the related PRs so we can re-run combined link-check. :thumbsup:
Maya: will do.
